qaMethod.visual: All selected sheets reviewed for12 evolving forms, correct direction, chronological phases and absence of religious icons/characters/text. Actual dark composites reviewed at stages3-8 for slashV1,pressureV1,ultimateV2,dashV2; flat artistic end cutoffs in ultimateV1 corrected in V2.
qaMethod.technical: Read-only Pillow metadata/hash/alpha inspection. All selected sheets RGBA1448×1086 with4×3 equal362px cells. Alpha>128 boundary counts zero. Alpha>8 is a diagnostic; isolated visually negligible fringe/dust is waived only with recorded dark-composite evidence. Hash difference alone is not motion-quality approval.
qaMethod.scope: Source QA remains separate from integrated runtime playback/ground/contact/mobile QA and user visual approval.

runtimeSizing: Source padding is not display extent. Runtime/packing must normalize the intended visible effect bounds so the battlefield AOE retains its designed width.
